digest.component_or_area: file impact tracking and declaration system
propositions: The empty file_impact field is overloaded with two meanings (author forgot vs. no files touched); the system needs an explicit third state to distinguish these cases

file_impact_scope must support three values (undeclared, paths, none) with derivation rules: non-empty file_impact yields 'paths', empty file_impact with payload scope 'none' yields 'none', otherwise 'undeclared'
CLI set-file-impact must migrate from fixed-arity _REGISTRY to variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY to support both array form and new --none flag form with mandatory reason validation
The no_file_impact_reason must contain at least 10 non-whitespace characters; shorter reasons reject with exit code 2 and no event written
get_file_impact_scope library function returns a dict with kind, reason, and paths; declare_no_file_impact MCP tool writes via the same mechanism as CLI with identical validation
Last-writer-wins semantics in process_file_impact ensure the three states remain mutually exclusive when events are replayed
